title: The b24 LOGNORM decode measures Excel's internal ln, not either LOGNORM surface
status_plain: The only W109 figure touching LOGNORM is an instrument reading: a LOGNORM surface was used as a window onto Excel's internal logarithm, and the 2,151 rows score the PRIMITIVE, establishing that the internal log is correctly rounded. The sentence names no LOGNORM surface, so which of LOGNORM.DIST and LOGNORMDIST was probed is not resolvable. The 849 "interval rows" are rows consistent with delta zero, not misses, and must never be published as a shortfall.

counts.build_note: Not restated near the figure. The only build statement in the W109 identification note is scoped to one battery -- "## The multi-view collapse (battery B1, 829 probes, build 20131)" at line 15 -- and the catalogue's build sentence describes the 48-case 2026-07-10 recon corpus, not these batteries. Not inherited.
counts.ambiguity_note: This scores Excel's INTERNAL ln, read through a LOGNORM surface as a window. It is not a pass rate for either LOGNORM surface, and the source names neither spelling, so the count scope is not resolvable. The 849 interval rows in the same sentence are consistent rows, not misses.
counts.source_sentence: LOGNORM candidate-matched decode (b24: 2,151 RN-exact rows all delta 0; 849 interval rows all contain 0; zero routing surprises; BINOM residue slope AND intercept 0.0000 ULP to n=720; WEIBULL residue 0+-0.003)
